llm_wiki_session_context.text:
# LLM Wiki Session Context

Canonical vault root: `$LLM_WIKI`
Current project: `$WORKSPACE`
Status: `ready`; markdown=5, sources=1, concepts=1, entities=0, summaries=0, sessions=0.

## When to use

Use llm-wiki only when durable memory, previous decisions, repository reference cards, citation-backed local knowledge, or explicit capture/update work would materially improve the task. Do not query it reflexively for every prompt.

## How to use through agent-harness

- Search: call MCP tool `llm_wiki_search` with focused terms.
- Read: call `llm_wiki_read` on returned relative paths or known slugs.
- Orient: read resource `harness://llm-wiki/index` or call `llm_wiki_inventory`.
- Capture: call `llm_wiki_capture` only for reusable findings or user-requested persistence.

## Hard constraints

- Read `00-meta/AGENTS.md` before wiki writes; this tool checks that schema exists before capture.
- Treat `10-sources/` bodies as read-only evidence; write synthesized knowledge to `20-wiki/` and session notes to `30-sessions/`.
- Preserve source fidelity, cite with Obsidian wikilinks, and mark synthesis or unverified claims explicitly.
- Never edit `.obsidian/`; archive obsolete pages instead of deleting.

## Current index excerpt

```markdown
---
title: Wiki Index
type: index
status: active
created: 2026-05-27
updated: 2026-05-27
tags: [meta]
---

- [[llm-wiki-pattern]]
```

execution_protocol: baseline: run 자기 검증 루프 and collect goal scores
curriculum: generate at least 10 improvement candidates using GENIUS_THINK.md formulas and repo evidence
selection: choose the highest score safe candidate, not the easiest cosmetic change
implementation: edit code/docs/skills with small reversible diffs
feedback: convert failures into Reflexion-style verbal lessons and retry within the cycle budget
termination: stop only when every 자가 증강 목표 and the 자기 검증 루프 goals score above target_score

goals.description: GENIUS_THINK.md와 repo evidence로 10개 이상 후보를 만들고 가치·위험·실현 가능성을 수치화한다.

이미 충족된 후보이므로 다음 자가 증강 cycle에서는 선택하지 않는다

execution_protocol: baseline: run 자기 검증 루프 and collect goal scores
curriculum: generate at least 10 improvement candidates using GENIUS_THINK.md formulas and repo evidence
selection: choose the highest score safe candidate, not the easiest cosmetic change
implementation: edit code/docs/skills with small reversible diffs
feedback: convert failures into Reflexion-style verbal lessons and retry within the cycle budget
termination: stop only when every 자가 증강 목표 and the 자기 검증 루프 goals score above target_score

goals.description: GENIUS_THINK.md와 repo evidence로 10개 이상 후보를 만들고 가치·위험·실현 가능성을 수치화한다.
goals.name: curriculum_selection

goals.description: 선택 후보를 실제 코드/문서/스킬 diff로 구현한다. 단순 보고서만으로는 통과하지 않는다.
goals.name: implementation_delta

goals.description: 타깃 테스트, QA 스모크, 자기 검증 루프를 통과해야 한다.
goals.name: verification_qa

goals.description: 실패/성공 원인과 다음 개선점을 state/docs/wiki 중 적절한 위치에 남긴다.
goals.name: learning_capture
